bullet_facts.fact: Kelly and Ryan have a romantic relationship that has experienced ups and downs.
Ryan confesses, "We're back together again baby." and "They tried to keep us apart, but they couldnt. It was like destiny."
Ryan tells Kelly, "I want to marry you, Kelly Kapoor. Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but someday, and probably."
Ryan expresses his love, "I love you, Kelly." and "Even if the odds are fifty-fifty that we'll break up within the week, I wanna roll those dice."
Kelly states, "You mean so much to me. But, I love Ravi and I choose him."
